title: Outlook: folder sharing respects organisation restrictions on Default and Anonymous permissions
summary: The roadmap facts and documented surrounding controls are supported, and the briefing clearly distinguishes those controls from the still-undocumented feature implementation. One minor clarification is needed: Microsoft's folder-permission instructions say Update after creating a configuration, while its Cloud Policy overview says Create for new configurations and Update for changes.
